sourceTitle: New Google AdMob AI tools help app creators build, fix, and grow faster
originalTitle: New Google AdMob AI tools help app creators build, fix, and grow faster
author: Naomi Ben-Ayoun

blocks.text: Building a successful mobile app means balancing a great user experience with ads monetization. But manually managing ad setups, fixing integration errors, and auditing brand safety pulls your team’s focus away from building. To help you simplify operations and accelerate your productivity, we’re introducing new AI tools for AdMob, Ask AdMob, agent skills and an MCP server. These new tools, built with Google AI, can help you earn more revenue and build your app business faster.
blocks.zh: 打造一款成功的移动应用意味着要在出色的用户体验与广告变现之间取得平衡。但手动管理广告设置、修复集成错误以及审核品牌安全，会让团队分散本应投入构建的精力。为了帮助您简化运营并提高生产力，我们推出了面向 AdMob 的新 AI 工具：Ask AdMob、智能体技能和 MCP 服务器。这些基于 Google AI 构建的新工具可帮助您获得更多收入，并更快地发展应用业务。
blocks.en: Building a successful mobile app means balancing a great user experience with ads monetization. But manually managing ad setups, fixing integration errors, and auditing brand safety pulls your team’s focus away from building. To help you simplify operations and accelerate your productivity, we’re introducing new AI tools for AdMob, Ask AdMob, agent skills and an MCP server. These new tools, built with Google AI, can help you earn more revenue and build your app business faster.

blocks.text: Fine-tune your monetization with Ask AdMob
blocks.zh: 使用 Ask AdMob 微调您的变现方式
blocks.en: Fine-tune your monetization with Ask AdMob

blocks.text: Ask AdMob, a conversational agent built with Gemini, will live directly in your AdMob account. Trained on AdMob monetization best practices, it can help fix issues, find revenue opportunities, and protect your brand safety like an AdMob product expert. Here are a few examples of what Ask AdMob can do for you.
blocks.zh: Ask AdMob 是一个基于 Gemini 构建的对话式智能体，将直接内置于您的 AdMob 账号中。它经过 AdMob 变现最佳实践的训练，能够像 AdMob 产品专家一样帮助您修复问题、发现收入机会并保护品牌安全。以下是 Ask AdMob 可以为您做的一些示例。
blocks.en: Ask AdMob, a conversational agent built with Gemini, will live directly in your AdMob account. Trained on AdMob monetization best practices, it can help fix issues, find revenue opportunities, and protect your brand safety like an AdMob product expert. Here are a few examples of what Ask AdMob can do for you.

blocks.text: Find and fix setup issues, skipping the manual guesswork: The troubleshooting hub will help you spot setup anomalies and SDK integration issues. Ask AdMob has visibility into how ads are loading in your app so it can highlight recommendations to resolve issues impacting your revenue.
blocks.zh: 发现并修复设置问题，省去手动猜测：故障排查中心将帮助您发现设置异常和 SDK 集成问题。Ask AdMob 能够了解广告在您的应用中的加载情况，因此可以重点给出建议，解决影响收入的问题。
blocks.en: Find and fix setup issues, skipping the manual guesswork: The troubleshooting hub will help you spot setup anomalies and SDK integration issues. Ask AdMob has visibility into how ads are loading in your app so it can highlight recommendations to resolve issues impacting your revenue.

blocks.text: Identify new revenue opportunities: Ask AdMob uses peer benchmarks to recommend high-value SDK bidders with predicted revenue uplifts to add to your setup and help optimize your mediation groups. For example, Ask AdMob will automatically check your third-party network configuration to catch costly typos and floor price discrepancies before they impact your yield.
blocks.zh: 发现新的收入机会：Ask AdMob 利用同行基准数据，推荐具有预测收入提升的高价值 SDK 出价方，将其添加到您的设置中，并帮助优化中介组。例如，Ask AdMob 会自动检查您的第三方广告网络配置，在代价高昂的拼写错误和底价差异影响收益之前发现它们。
blocks.en: Identify new revenue opportunities: Ask AdMob uses peer benchmarks to recommend high-value SDK bidders with predicted revenue uplifts to add to your setup and help optimize your mediation groups. For example, Ask AdMob will automatically check your third-party network configuration to catch costly typos and floor price discrepancies before they impact your yield.

blocks.text: Create effective brand safety rules with natural language: Instead of manually managing blocklists, you can configure custom brand safety rules using simple, natural-language prompts in your AdMob UI.
blocks.zh: 使用自然语言创建有效的品牌安全规则：您无需手动管理屏蔽名单，即可在 AdMob 界面中使用简单的自然语言提示配置自定义品牌安全规则。
blocks.en: Create effective brand safety rules with natural language: Instead of manually managing blocklists, you can configure custom brand safety rules using simple, natural-language prompts in your AdMob UI.

blocks.text: We’ll begin testing these capabilities over the next few months and continue evolving Ask AdMob with more advanced features to take action on your behalf later next year. As always, you remain in control, reviewing and approving every recommendation before it’s applied.
blocks.zh: 我们将在未来几个月内开始测试这些功能，并在明年晚些时候继续为 Ask AdMob 推出更高级的功能，以便代您采取行动。一如既往，您始终掌握控制权，每项建议在应用之前都会经过您的审核和批准。
blocks.en: We’ll begin testing these capabilities over the next few months and continue evolving Ask AdMob with more advanced features to take action on your behalf later next year. As always, you remain in control, reviewing and approving every recommendation before it’s applied.

blocks.text: Manage ad setups directly with your AI agent
blocks.zh: 直接使用您的智能体管理广告设置
blocks.en: Manage ad setups directly with your AI agent

blocks.text: Previously, setting up ad placements meant clicking through web dashboards, copying and pasting ad unit IDs, and managing ad configuration files outside your codebase. With AdMob agent skills and an upcoming MCP server, we’re giving you the tools to enable your preferred AI agent to build, edit, and validate ad code for your app.
blocks.zh: 过去，设置广告位意味着在网页信息中心中点击操作、复制粘贴广告单元 ID，并在代码库之外管理广告配置文件。借助 AdMob 智能体技能和即将推出的 MCP 服务器，我们为您提供工具，让您偏好的智能体能够为您的应用构建、编辑和验证广告代码。
blocks.en: Previously, setting up ad placements meant clicking through web dashboards, copying and pasting ad unit IDs, and managing ad configuration files outside your codebase. With AdMob agent skills and an upcoming MCP server, we’re giving you the tools to enable your preferred AI agent to build, edit, and validate ad code for your app.

blocks.text: AdMob agent skills give your AI agent pre-built, tested playbooks to implement coding tasks like, migrating to the Google Mobile Ads Next-Gen SDK, validating your SDK implementation, and implementing new ad formats in your app. Find these skills and more on our developer site.
blocks.zh: AdMob 智能体技能为您的智能体提供预先构建并经过测试的操作手册，用于执行编码任务，例如迁移到 Google Mobile Ads Next-Gen SDK、验证 SDK 实现，以及在应用中实现新的广告格式。请在我们的开发者网站上查找这些技能及更多内容。
blocks.en: AdMob agent skills give your AI agent pre-built, tested playbooks to implement coding tasks like, migrating to the Google Mobile Ads Next-Gen SDK, validating your SDK implementation, and implementing new ad formats in your app. Find these skills and more on our developer site.

blocks.text: While agent skills can help you implement tasks today, we’re also working on an AdMob MCP server to connect your developer environments directly with AdMob. Soon your AI agent will be able to read account data, write new ad units, and manage mediation settings. All you have to do is review and approve the updates before you push them to production. This is in early testing and will be expanding to more developers early next year.
blocks.zh: 虽然智能体技能如今可以帮助你执行任务，但我们也在开发一个 AdMob MCP 服务器，以便将你的开发者环境直接与 AdMob 连接。不久之后，你的智能体将能够读取账户数据、创建新的广告单元并管理中介设置。你只需在将更新推送到生产环境之前进行审核和批准。该功能目前处于早期测试阶段，明年初将扩展到更多开发者。
blocks.en: While agent skills can help you implement tasks today, we’re also working on an AdMob MCP server to connect your developer environments directly with AdMob. Soon your AI agent will be able to read account data, write new ad units, and manage mediation settings. All you have to do is review and approve the updates before you push them to production. This is in early testing and will be expanding to more developers early next year.

blocks.text: Prepare your business for a more agentic 2027
blocks.zh: 让你的企业为更加智能体驱动的 2027 年做好准备
blocks.en: Prepare your business for a more agentic 2027

blocks.text: Throughout 2027, we’ll introduce a much broader and more advanced wave of AI tools for app developers — expanding both in-product and AI agent capabilities. These tools will handle more of the routine operational workload so you can focus on what matters most: your product, your users, and your business.
blocks.zh: 在整个 2027 年，我们将为应用开发者推出一波更广泛、更先进的 AI 工具——同时扩展产品内功能和智能体能力。这些工具将承担更多日常运营工作负载，让你可以专注于最重要的事情：你的产品、用户和业务。
blocks.en: Throughout 2027, we’ll introduce a much broader and more advanced wave of AI tools for app developers — expanding both in-product and AI agent capabilities. These tools will handle more of the routine operational workload so you can focus on what matters most: your product, your users, and your business.
